summary: Conviction under RPC s.420, s.468, s.471 and PC Act s.5(1)(d) & s.5(2); forgery of infant to adult air ticket; handwriting evidence and witness testimony confirm manipulation by appellant; concurrent findings upheld; expert opinion supports guilt; no illegality found in reappreciation by High Court; appeal dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Ranbir Penal Code s.420, s.468, s.471
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.5(1)(d), s.5(2)
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld.
